`final class VulkanSnapshotBackend`<br/>
**Implements:** [`ISnapshotBackend`](/reference/testing/isnapshotbackend/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.snapshot` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanSnapshotBackend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/snapshot/VulkanSnapshotBackend.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The snapshot backend of Vulkan, which renders through a `SnapshotVulkanHost` into an offscreen image.

## Description

A hidden GLFW window without client API gives the window and input bridges; it ships in the dev and demo jars of the backend.
